title: Covenant Compliance Certificate
description: Covenant Compliance Certificate contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-covenant-compliance-certificate
  title: Covenant Compliance Certificate
  description: Covenant Compliance Certificate contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_covenant_compliance_certificate_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/covenant_compliance_certificate
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/covenant_compliance_certificate
    sourceVersion: fs_covenant_compliance_certificate_v1
    sourceDigest: 19794ea24829bb20bb49cb8791ba70ccf4717a637f5854996e3ad45b90a5de77
spec:
  role: completion
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Covenant Compliance Certificate
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: certificate-date
              name: certificate_date
              label: Certificate Date
              description: Date signed or delivered.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
            - id: reporting-period-end-date
              name: reporting_period_end_date
              label: Reporting Period End Date
              description: Financial reporting period end.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
              required: true
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: agreement-reference
              name: agreement_reference
              label: Agreement Reference
              description: Loan agreement name/date referenced.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: signer-title
              name: signer_title
              label: Signer Title
              description: Signer title.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: dscr-required
              name: dscr_required
              label: Dscr Required
              description: Required debt service coverage ratio.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: dscr-actual
              name: dscr_actual
              label: Dscr Actual
              description: Actual DSCR.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: leverage-required
              name: leverage_required
              label: Leverage Required
              description: Required maximum leverage ratio.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: leverage-actual
              name: leverage_actual
              label: Leverage Actual
              description: Actual leverage ratio.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: liquidity-required
              name: liquidity_required
              label: Liquidity Required
              description: Required minimum liquidity.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: liquidity-actual
              name: liquidity_actual
              label: Liquidity Actual
              description: Actual liquidity.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: net-worth-required
              name: net_worth_required
              label: Net Worth Required
              description: Required minimum net worth.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: net-worth-actual
              name: net_worth_actual
              label: Net Worth Actual
              description: Actual net worth.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: borrowing-base-required
              name: borrowing_base_required
              label: Borrowing Base Required
              description: Required borrowing base or availability.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: borrowing-base-actual
              name: borrowing_base_actual
              label: Borrowing Base Actual
              description: Actual borrowing base or availability.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: financial-statements-attached
              name: financial_statements_attached
              label: Financial Statements Attached
              description: Whether financial statements are attached or certified.
              dataType: boolean
              widget: checkbox
        - id: line-items
          title: Line Items
          description: Line Items fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: exceptions-or-waivers
              name: exceptions_or_waivers
              label: Exceptions Or Waivers
              description: Exceptions, waivers, cure periods, or explanations.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: borrower-name
              name: borrower_name
              label: Borrower Name
              description: Borrower or obligor.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: lender-name
              name: lender_name
              label: Lender Name
              description: Lender, bank, or administrative agent.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: signer-name
              name: signer_name
              label: Signer Name
              description: Authorized signer.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: risk-and-compliance
          title: Risk And Compliance
          description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: compliance-status
              name: compliance_status
              label: Compliance Status
              description: In compliance, not in compliance, default, waiver requested, or other.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: default-declared
              name: default_declared
              label: Default Declared
              description: Whether a default or event of default is disclosed.
              dataType: boolean
              widget: checkbox
  validationRules:
    - id: borrower-name-present
      severity: error
      description: Certificate must identify the borrower.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: borrower_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: borrower_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: borrower_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(borrower_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: reporting-period-present
      severity: warning
      description: Reporting period is required to evaluate covenant compliance.
      rule:
        op: present
        field: reporting_period_end_date
      sourceExpression: reporting_period_end_date IS NOT NULL
      supported: true
    - id: compliance-status-present
      severity: warning
      description: Compliance status should be explicitly captured or reviewed.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: compliance_status
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: compliance_status
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: compliance_status IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(compliance_status)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: actual-ratios-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: Actual covenant ratios should not be negative.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: or
            rules:
              - op: not
                rule:
                  op: present
                  field: dscr_actual
              - op: gte
                left:
                  field: dscr_actual
                right:
                  value: 0
          - op: or
            rules:
              - op: not
                rule:
                  op: present
                  field: leverage_actual
              - op: gte
                left:
                  field: leverage_actual
                right:
                  value: 0
      sourceExpression: (dscr_actual IS NULL OR dscr_actual >= 0) AND (leverage_actual IS NULL OR leverage_actual >= 0)
      supported: true
    - id: exceptions-array-valid
      severity: warning
      description: Exceptions and waivers should be represented as an array.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: exceptions_or_waivers
          - op: gte
            left:
              length: exceptions_or_waivers
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: exceptions_or_waivers IS NULL OR JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(exceptions_or_waivers) >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      borrower_name:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Borrower identity links the certificate to a credit facility.
      reporting_period_end_date:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Reporting period controls covenant timeliness.
      compliance_status:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Compliance status routes exceptions and defaults.
      default_declared:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Default disclosures require prompt credit action.
      dscr_actual:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Actual DSCR is a core covenant measurement.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 4096
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Compliance certificates are semi-structured but require accurate extraction of ratios, thresholds,
      reporting periods, and default statements.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      certificate_date:
        type: date
        description: Date signed or delivered.
        format: date
      reporting_period_end_date:
        type: date
        description: Financial reporting period end.
        format: date
      borrower_name:
        type: string
        description: Borrower or obligor.
      lender_name:
        type: string
        description: Lender, bank, or administrative agent.
      agreement_reference:
        type: string
        description: Loan agreement name/date referenced.
      signer_name:
        type: string
        description: Authorized signer.
      signer_title:
        type: string
        description: Signer title.
      compliance_status:
        type: string
        description: In compliance, not in compliance, default, waiver requested, or other.
      default_declared:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether a default or event of default is disclosed.
      dscr_required:
        type: number
        description: Required debt service coverage ratio.
      dscr_actual:
        type: number
        description: Actual DSCR.
      leverage_required:
        type: number
        description: Required maximum leverage ratio.
      leverage_actual:
        type: number
        description: Actual leverage ratio.
      liquidity_required:
        type: number
        description: Required minimum liquidity.
      liquidity_actual:
        type: number
        description: Actual liquidity.
      net_worth_required:
        type: number
        description: Required minimum net worth.
      net_worth_actual:
        type: number
        description: Actual net worth.
      borrowing_base_required:
        type: number
        description: Required borrowing base or availability.
      borrowing_base_actual:
        type: number
        description: Actual borrowing base or availability.
      exceptions_or_waivers:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Exceptions, waivers, cure periods, or explanations.
      financial_statements_attached:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether financial statements are attached or certified.
    required:
      - reporting_period_end_date
      - borrower_name
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - reporting_period_end_date
            - borrower_name
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - line_items
            - parties
            - risk_and_compliance
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields: []
